{{unknown name}} [[File:Boy PT10.png|250px|thumb|The protagonist and Primeape]] This unnamed '''boy''' (Japanese: '''少年''' ''boy'') is the protagonist of [[PT10]]. The boy decided to do an observation report on his partner {{p|Primeape}} and discover what Primeape looked like when it wasn't angry. He tried various activities, such as food, meditation, and vacations, but all of them only served to fuel Primeape's rage. Eventually he realized Primeape enjoyed battling and the two began challenging everyone they could. This led to them winning over and over until they ended up fighting the [[Champion]]. A hard-fought battle ended in their victory, which the boy thought had to be enough to satisfy Primeape. However, it evolved into {{p|Annihilape}} and continued to rage. Ever determined, the boy announced his next observation report would be on Annihilape. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Boy's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in [[POKÉTOON]]: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Boy |pkmn=Annihilape |type1=Fighting |type2=Ghost |stage1=Primeape |img=Boy PT10 Primeape.png |img2=Boy PT10 Annihilape.png |epnum=PT10 |epname= |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Mitsuo Iwata |desc={{p|Annihilape}} is the boy's only known Pokémon. It was originally a {{p|Primeape}} that the boy decided to do an observation report on to see what Primeape looked like when it wasn't angry, as it tended to explode at every situation. Primeape went along with multiple activities before expressing that what it truly enjoyed was battling. Fueled by this, the two started challenging everyone they could find and eventually made it to the championship match against a {{p|Baxcalibur}}. Primeape's Rage Fist clashed against {{m|Glaive Rush}}, with Primeape ending up as the winner. The boy assumed this would satisfy Primeape, but it evolved into Annihilape and continued its explosive attitude.
